alex_sales: Hey @marta_legal @olivia_finance quick sync on the Equinox POC — customer needs a signed orderform today. Two immediate blockers: they want 99.99% SLA for the POC (we normally only offer 99.9/POC) and they require a dual-signer flow (Procurement + Legal). Also asking for KMS with HSM mention in the DPA. Any fast path? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

marta_legal: Short answer: we can usually relax for POC but 99.99 is material. I can propose a timeboxed SLA amendment for the POC window but would prefer 99.95 max without GC sign-off. For DPA/KMS HSM language I can add an exhibit referencing customer-provided key usage? Need security approval from @sam_eng.

olivia_finance: Net30 ok. For esign: do they prefer DocuSign or plain email acceptance with PO? If they want a PO we can accept it to billing@redwood.com and issue invoice. If DocuSign, we need signer mapping in the orderform to route two signatures.

sam_eng: Tech note: if we go Private (customer asked) onboarding for landing zone + IP allowlist + SAML will be ~48–72 hrs min (infra ticket + infra eng pair). Hosted w/ VPC peering could be faster but won't satisfy HSM KMS unless we do customer-managed key material (adds 24–48 hrs). Also they requested KMS audit logs retained 90 days — we can commit to logs retention but need to confirm KMS provider SLA.

alex_sales: Customer is pushing because the demo with live traffic starts tomorrow. They said "we only sign if SLA 99.99 + HSM clause". Can we do a temporary concession limited to POC scope + limited credits? Example proposal: SLA 99.95 for POC window + max credit 25% monthly fee if breached. Thoughts?

marta_legal: That compromise is workable as a one-off amendment. I'll draft a one-page POC addendum: set SLA to 99.95 for dates X–Y, credits capped at 25% of POC fees, no long-term precedent. I'll include signer roles and a clause allowing signed PO as alternate acceptance. Need confirmation from finance re: PO acceptance.

olivia_finance: Confirmed: we can accept PO from Equinox legal procurement team to billing@redwood.com. For faster processing, request their PO number on the DocuSign envelope or in the PO email. Wire info will be standard; I'll send payment instructions once PO is received.

sam_eng: For HSM wording: we can say "customer-managed key material and HSM-backed key storage supported where deployed on Private" and add a conditional sentence that Hosted may use provider-managed keys unless customer requests and provisions key material. I'll validate exact phrasing with security, but yes we can include a conditional HSM exhibit.

alex_sales: Perfect — next steps:
- Marta: redline / one-page POC addendum by 14:00 PT (include SLA 99.95 and signer mapping)
- Olivia: confirm PO email flow & send wire/invoice template to customer if they request
- Sam: confirm HSM exhibit phrasing + landing zone ETA (48h)
I'll message the customer with this path and ask them to choose: DocuSign dual-sign or PO to billing.

marta_legal: I'll also add a short clause: `signer_roles: ["Procurement","Legal"]` in the orderform metadata and a fallback: `acceptance: ["DocuSign","PO-email"]`. Sending initial redline in 20m.

olivia_finance: If they send PO, we'll fast-track invoice same day. Otherwise DocuSign route is fine — add `procurement_email` and `legal_email` fields in the envelope.

sam_eng: FYI for onboarding ticket I created INC-4291 with steps + owner @infra-team, ETA 48h if they provide SAML metadata and target CIDR. Link: https://redwood-internal/infra/INC-4291

alex_sales: Awesome. I'll update Equinox and ask them to confirm signer emails and whether they'll send PO. Thanks team :raised_hands:

qa-bot: Reminder: attach the POC test plan to the orderform before sending. See checklist: `https://confluence/redwood/poc-checklist`
